body:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-8472 — metering-routing-fallback — severity: P1. Rule: metering.pipeline.routing.fallback.rate > 0.5 for 5m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-8472

pagerduty: @dave-oncall you were notified. Escalation level 1. Auto-annotated: 'routing-fallback to region-b causes token-count deltas'

 dave-oncall: ack. I'm on it. Paging SRE + Billing. (assigned)

 alice-sre: picking up triage. seeing increased fallback events from router-proxy in us-east-1 -> queued to backup-nodegroup. Starting log tail on metering-ingest: `kubectl -n metering logs -l app=metering-ingest --since=10m`

 bob-ml: what symptoms? customers reporting invoice deltas?

 carol-billing: finance flagged two near-real-time invoices showing token counts ~2-5% lower than expected for several enterprise accounts. Potential billing risk if counts stay low for next billing run.

 alice-sre: here's a sample from the ingest logs (redacted):
```
[2026-03-14T12:07:03Z] WARN router: fallback to fallback-pool (reason=kvcache-miss, route=region-b)
[2026-03-14T12:07:03Z] INFO ingest: accepted batch id=0xa12f tokens=2048 user=acct-1234 source=dedicated
[2026-03-14T12:07:04Z] ERROR pipeline.commit: sequence-gap detected seq_from=345678 seq_to=345678 acked=345677
```
Looks like routing path change + commit gap.

 emma-platform: I see recent config rollout 2026-03-14T11:55 -> staging->prod: router routing-policy v3.2.4 that added 'prefer-latency' path. Could be related. Rolling back would be quick but need risk assessment.

 dave-oncall: @emma-platform what's the blast radius of a rollback? Any DB migrations?

 emma-platform: none. It's just routing policy in router-config map. Rolling to previous stable (v3.2.3) takes ~10min to apply and ~5min to re-warm caches.

 alice-sre: meanwhile I'm running a token reconciliation job to estimate drift: `python tools/reconcile_tokens.py --window 30m --sample 1000`

 frank-support: customers pinged support; highest risk accounts: acct-1234, acct-9876, acct-5552. They're flagged in Zendesk tickets #3852 #3853. Please advise on mitigation ASAP.

 carol-billing: If token counts keep underreporting we may trigger invoice holds. Need ETA for mitigation.

 alice-sre: initial reconcile shows ~3.1% undercount across sampled users correlated with fallback periods. Full job still running, ETA ~8m.

 dave-oncall: decision call: short-term mitigation = rollback routing-policy to v3.2.3 to stop fallback. Longer term we need root cause for kvcache misses. @alice-sre please coordinate rollback with @emma-platform.

 alice-sre: initiating rollback now. `kubectl apply -f router-config-v3.2.3.yaml -n infra`

 incident-bot: deploy bot: router-config update started by alice-sre (rollout id r-20260314-01).

 emma-platform: rollout applied. Observability: router-proxy pod restarts beginning. Watching for reduced fallback rate.

 alice-sre: fallback rate metric dropping from 0.62 -> 0.08 within 90s. Good sign.

 bob-ml: any change in sequence-gap errors?

 alice-sre: seq-gap errors reduced to near-zero within 3m. Reconcile job updated: now showing ~0.2% undercount sampled.

 carol-billing: phew. 0.2% is within margin. We should still run backfill for the affected window to be safe. What's the window?

 alice-sre: affected window roughly 11:56-12:12 UTC (16 minutes). I'll kick off backfill job: `./tools/backfill_ingest.sh --from 2026-03-14T11:56 --to 2026-03-14T12:12 --priority=high`

 frank-support: I'll notify the customers with a brief status update: "We've mitigated the cause and are running a backfill; invoices will be recomputed if needed. We'll follow up when backfill completes."

 dave-oncall: @carol-billing do we want to place any pending invoices on hold preemptively?

 carol-billing: not yet. Wait for full reconciliation output. If backfill recovers >99.5% we'll proceed normally. If not, we'll create manual adjustments.

 alice-sre: backfill kicked off, job id bf-20260314-11. Progress: 0% -> 45% after 120s. Streaming progress: `curl http://backfill.internal/jobs/bf-20260314-11/status`

 incident-bot: PagerDuty note appended: PD-8472 status=ack, summary="routing-policy rollback applied; backfill started"

 dave-oncall: handing off to night oncall @bob-ml in 25m. Bob, accepted?

 bob-ml: I got it. I'll monitor until backfill completes and reconcile output posted. If anything re-escalates, I'll page SRE.

 gina-cs: flagged impacted customers in CS dashboard and added note to incident timeline.

 alice-sre: backfill complete. Summary: recovered ~99.88% of missing tokens for sampled accounts. Final delta per acct <= 0.12%

 carol-billing: confirmed reconciliation results. No manual invoice holds required. Will mark invoices as OK and proceed with normal run.

 frank-support: sent customer updates to tickets: "incident mitigated; no billing changes required."

 dave-oncall: closing PD on my side in 10m if stable. Any lingering asks?

 bob-ml: I'll keep an eye on related metrics for 1h, but dropping off.

 alice-sre: follow-up items (tracking in GH):
- investigate root cause of kvcache-miss during routing-policy change (assigned alice-sre)
- add a canary check before routing-policy rollouts (assigned emma-platform)
- add alert to detect sequence-gap spikes tied to routing changes (assigned dave-oncall)

 carol-billing: thanks everyone. Adding notes to billing postmortem queue in Notion.

 dave-oncall: PD closed by dave-oncall at 2026-03-14T13:15:00Z. Incident thread will be archived. :white_check_mark:
